name: Boing
hint: Hop onto a spring and it throws you 5 high. Steer in the air.
why4: The 4-high step needs two friends underneath for each climber, and the lid over the spring only opens with the two climbers on the 2-plate up top.
solution: Each player hops onto the spring at x=11 (walking onto it does nothing; land on it squarely) and holds Right in the air: it launches 5.5 high and they land on the cliff top (height 5, face at x=14).
The first one up (say P4) touches the key at x=20 on the way and later sets it down in front of P3 (P3 picks it up).
P4 stands against the step at x=29; P3 jumps onto P4's head.
P2 jumps onto P3's head, then right onto the step (4 high). P1 does the same.
P2 and P1 stand on the plate at x=33-34 (2/2): the lid A at x=27 (flush with the cliff top) opens, showing a spring one tile down.
P3 hops down; P3 and then P4 each step into the hole at x=27, land on the spring and steer right onto the step (launch peaks 4.5 above the cliff top; the step is 4).
P3 opens the door at x=44; all four press Down.
